question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Mrs. Sharma found her husband to be a __sloppy__ dresser.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Meticulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sloppy"** means careless, untidy, or lacking attention to detail. (असावधान, अस्त-व्यस्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The sloppy handwriting made the document hard to read.
 
 
 
• **"Meticulous"** refers to showing great attention to detail; being very careful and precise. (अत्यंत सावधान, सूक्ष्म दृष्टि वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** She is meticulous in her work, ensuring everything is done perfectly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"sloppy"** is **"meticulous"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Meticulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Untidy **(अस्त-व्यस्त): Not neat or organized; messy.

 
 
• **Example:** His untidy room made it difficult to find anything.
 
 
 
• **Shabby **(घिसा-पिटा, जीर्ण): Showing signs of wear and tear; neglected or in poor condition.
 
 
• **Example:** The shabby sofa had been in the family for generations.
 
 
 
• **Messy **(गंदा, अव्यवस्थित): Disorganized or dirty.
 
 
• **Example:** The messy table was covered with books and papers.
